title: REDE exploratory research summary
author: Jaya Krishna J

reproduction.reason: Raw benchmark predictions, normalized RoboArena metadata, and generated analysis artifacts remain outside Git by design.

claims_boundary: The benchmark references are human-verified single-verifier references, not independent multi-rater gold labels.
The target is the finite released benchmark set; external generalization is unverified.
Model selection and method development inspected released test artifacts, so current label-efficiency results are exploratory.
Decision changes are descriptive and are not presented as family-wise-error-controlled hypothesis tests.
No robot-safety, deployment, causal, or certification claim is made.
